name: Hopf
author: E. T. Carter
description: The Hopf fibration on a post on a dark studio floor: every point of a sphere becomes a ring, and every ring links every other. Three nested tori of fourteen rings each, every ring threaded through all the rest, breathe and slide round one another, each ring coloured by where it sits on the sphere so the theme runs round them in bands. The post is a ring too, the one through the far pole, projected to a straight line.

sculpture.label: The Hopf fibration: every point of a sphere becomes a ring, each linked through every other, nested as three tori that slide round one another.
